About the author

Ben Rowland is an independent author writing about ancient history, religion, philosophy and the political systems that shaped the Western world. His work explores the origins of Indo-European cultures, the beliefs and traditions of pre-Christian Europe, and the history of ancient Rome. He is particularly interested in how mythology, political ambition and the accounts of ancient writers have influenced our understanding of the past. His books include Wandering Gods, an exploration of Indo-European religion and pagan traditions, and The Necessary Emperor: How Augustus Ended the Republic and Created an Empire, a detailed examination of the Roman Republic's collapse, the rise of Augustus and the creation of the Principate. Through his writing, he seeks to look beyond familiar historical narratives, examining the evidence, challenging long-established assumptions and exploring the complex realities behind some of history's most influential figures and events.
